title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 4: Mirei Kuroda
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．４ ～黒田美礼～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol.4: Kuroda Mirei is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Mirei Kuroda. It includes a gallery of photos and interview questions, as well as a simple quiz minigame with questions about the idol. Clearing all rounds of the quiz will give the player a password and instructions to enter a prize drawing with Genki's publishing label SadaSoft.
